questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses inversion to emphasise the speaker’s surprise at the news?
options: It was surprising that she had won the competition despite not being a professional.
Surprising was she to learn that her colleague had resigned unexpectedly.
She was surprised to find out that the meeting had been cancelled due to a last-minute change.
The reason she was disappointed was that the invitation had been sent to the wrong person.
questions.answer: Surprising was she to learn that her colleague had resigned unexpectedly.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly employs a cleft construction to clarify the cause of the argument?
options: The argument was caused by the way he interrupted her speech during the presentation.
It was the lack of preparation that led to their disagreement.
What really upset her was the tone in which he spoke about her work.
The issue was who should take responsibility for the project delay.
questions.answer: It was the lack of preparation that led to their disagreement.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses a third conditional structure with the subjunctive mood to express regret about past actions?
options: If I had known about the rules earlier, I would have prepared better for the exam.
If she had studied more diligently, she would have passed the course without effort.
If they had received the budget increase, they would have expanded the team significantly.
If he had arrived earlier, he would have avoided the traffic jam.
questions.answer: If she had studied more diligently, she would have passed the course without effort.

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses ellipsis to omit redundant information while maintaining grammatical coherence?
options: He didn’t tell me about the surprise party because he knew I’d be upset.
She left the room without saying goodbye, just like she always does.
The report was submitted on time, as promised, and received full marks.
They argued for hours over the smallest detail, which was completely irrelevant.
questions.answer: She left the room without saying goodbye, just like she always does.

questions.question: Which sentence demonstrates the correct formal register by using the passive voice with a modal verb to express necessity?
options: The project must be completed by Friday to avoid penalties.
It was essential that the data be analysed immediately to prevent further delays.
The manager insisted that all reports be submitted by the end of the week.
She required that the meeting be rescheduled due to unforeseen circumstances.
questions.answer: It was essential that the data be analysed immediately to prevent further delays.
